learnerTask: Locate lumen, epithelial cells, basement membrane and mixed stroma; distinguish a tissue boundary from individual cell membranes.
scientificScope: Generic simplified normal epithelial lining, not a breast-duct blueprint, measured proportions, malignancy claim or invasion test. RNA mark identifies a possible stromal cellular contributor, not an expression amount, cancer-cell target or treatment effect.

sources.support: Normal single-cell/spatial atlas and non-epithelial populations
sources.accessDepth: Actual primary abstract retrieved through NCBI EFetch; fibroblast identity also supported by retrieved indexed primary PMC passage; full article not newly retrieved

actualMechanism: Built-in image_gen tool; no CLI or external raster transformation
modelEvidence: Actual tool results returned only image_url and output_hint, with no model/version field.

lineage.disposition: Superseded after independent request to remove unassigned stromal oval flecks; original retained in author/reviewer custody, excluded from public payload

lineage.gate: Actual independent LIGHT02 PASS before generation

illustrativeObjectCounts.meaning: Artist-selected examples only; not measured tissue proportions

acceptanceScope: Provenance records creation and source limits only. Independent pair review, publication, deployed-reader acceptance and coverage accounting are separate evidence.
publicExclusions: Full third-party articles and source figures
